latest_release.name: PhotoGIMP 3.1
latest_release.body:
This release brings the latest PhotoGIMP improvements since version 3.0.

## Highlights

- Improved Photoshop-style keyboard shortcuts and tool organization.
- Added bracket-key shortcuts for changing brush size during editing.
- Added alpha channels automatically to imported images.
- Improved Flatpak launcher portability across distributions and architectures.
- Added improved macOS installation instructions, including an rsync alternative.
- Removed obsolete and redundant GIMP configuration files.
- Updated screenshots, icons and visual assets.
- Added or updated README translations in Spanish, Hebrew, Korean, Italian, Chinese, Russian, Polish and Portuguese.
- Expanded installation, troubleshooting and contribution documentation.

## Compatibility

- Designed for GIMP 3.0 and newer.
- Supports native package and Flatpak installations through the documented configuration paths.
- Back up your current GIMP configuration before installing.

## Full changelog
